title: Lesson
description: Schema for a single Fluent lesson file in content/lessons/{id}.json

track_id.description: ID of the track this lesson belongs to, must match an entry in tracks.json

title.description: Human-readable lesson title shown in the UI

xp.description: XP awarded to the user on lesson completion

steps.description: Ordered sequence of lesson steps. A complete lesson should have at least one of each: concept, see_it, try_it, lock_it.

ConceptStep.description: Introduces a concept with a heading and markdown body. No interaction required.

SeeItStep.description: Shows a worked example — a real prompt and its AI output.

body.description: Context explaining what the user is about to see

label.description: Short label shown above the example, e.g. 'The prompt used:'

content.description: The example prompt or AI output to display

TryItStep.description: Interactive exercise. The user writes a prompt that is scored by Claude.

subtype.description: Determines which interactive component renders this step

scenario.description: The situation presented to the learner — sets the context for their prompt

rubric.description: Used verbatim as the Claude system prompt when scoring the user's attempt. Be specific about what makes a good prompt in this context.

expert_prompt.description: A high-quality example prompt shown to the user after max_attempts are exhausted

max_attempts.description: How many tries the user gets before the expert_prompt is revealed

LockItStep.description: Multiple-choice comprehension check. Locks in the learning before the next lesson.

correct_index.description: Zero-based index into options[] of the correct answer

explanation.description: Shown after the user answers — explains why the correct answer is right
